text:
Your radar runs version
1.1.95. Please update it.

A. With a computer:
1. Plug the radar into a
computer with its cable.
2. In Chrome or Edge go to
locklinestudio.com/
radar/update
3. Password: takeoff

B. No computer? Try this.
It may not always work:
1. Settings > Map: off.
2. Set the range to 1.
3. Unplug 10 s, plug in.
4. Settings > System >
Check for update.
